headline: Amazon and Intel sink Nasdaq futures 2%, while our boring 3-month calls hold up: T-Mobile and NextEra beat the S&P 500 premarket; no Bold Bet again, Max leans 76ers
top_call: Nasdaq futures are down 2% after Amazon and Intel, and our boring 3-month calls are holding up. T-Mobile is about +1.6 points ahead of the S&P 500 before the bell, NextEra about +0.4, and Microsoft about even (-0.3) at 7 AM ET. Phone bills and power plants don't burn $42 billion on GPUs.
backdrop: Nasdaq-100 futures fell about 2% and S&P 500 futures about 1% early Friday after Amazon (down about 7% premarket) posted negative free cash flow and kept its $220 billion capex plan, and Intel slid about 25% on a weak outlook. Friday is October's last trading day; Exxon and Chevron report before the open.

ai.headline: Amazon falls about 7% premarket after missing estimates, with free cash flow of -$42.4 billion over 12 months and its $220 billion 2026 capex plan intact
ai.why: AWS grew 39% and nobody cared. The market is now grading AI on cash, and Amazon handed in a red-ink essay.

ai.headline: Intel sinks about 25% premarket, heading for its worst day ever, after guiding Q4 revenue to $15-16 billion vs $17.1 billion expected
ai.why: The AI boom lifts chip boats, unless your boat is mostly PCs. AMD and Broadcom slid too, so the whole chip aisle felt it.

ai.headline: Mistral releases the weights for Mistral Large 4, its 1-trillion-parameter 'Le Chonk' model, pitched at cyber defense
ai.why: A frontier-class model anyone can download and run on their own servers. Great for defenders, and Mistral itself admits attackers get a look too.

ai.headline: GitHub says AI agents started more than 40% of pull requests in September, up from 17% in March, and launches Copilot Fusion model routing
ai.why: 110 million agent-drafted code changes in one month. The robots aren't coming for coding, they're already in the pull request queue.

ai.headline: OpenAI stands up an Election Operations Center with hundreds of staff to watch for ChatGPT misuse through the Nov 3 midterms
ai.why: The first big AI lab with an election war room. Next Tuesday is the live test of whether chatbots can stay out of the headlines.

no_bets_note: Nothing cleared our bar at 7:10 AM ET.
